scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan with you. Could you tell me the status of my application? Also, was I approved or denied?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The loan was originated.

dialogue.user: Great to hear that my application was approved! What is the interest rate on the loan? And what are the total costs associated with this loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate on the loan is 5.75%. The total costs associated with the loan are $6,910.00.

dialogue.user: Thank you for providing that information. Are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have any negative amortization features. The loan has been sold to Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user: I see. What type of loan product was I approved for? And what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for a VA:First Lien loan product. The debt-to-income ratio is the ratio of your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income. In your case, it is 45%.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. I think that's all I need to know for now.

<Neutral> - The agent provided all the necessary information clearly and politely, but I was hoping for a more personalized explanation of the debt-to-income ratio and its implications.
